data.name: Ajmar
data.gender_notes: Ajmar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ajm', which means 'to smooth' or 'to soothe'. In Islamic tradition, Ajmar is a name for a gentle, kind, and compassionate person, reflecting the peaceful and benevolent nature of Allah. The name Ajmar carries the meaning “Gentle, kind, compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ajmar usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's compassion and kindness towards His creation.
data.etymology: Ajmar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, kind, compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajmar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Ajmar
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ajmar originates from the Arabic root 'جمـر' (jamar), which means to complete or to be perfect. It signifies someone who possesses unique qualities and stands out in their community. Ajmar conveys the idea of excellence, distinctiveness, and brilliance. Historically, names derived from this root have been associated with completeness and perfection in character.
